text:
🐶🐾 NEW DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 🐾🐶

Good news, everyone! ❤️ Our DMV Shih Tzu Meetup has officially been rescheduled! 🎉 We’re hoping for better weather so all our little fluffy friends can enjoy a fun day together. 🐾🥹

📅 Sunday, November 1st, 2026
⏰ 11:00 AM – 1:30 PM
📍 Hains Point Park – Site “A” 🌳

⚠️ Please remember that everyone must leave by 2:00 PM!

Thank you all for being so understanding about the rain and for being flexible with the change of plans! ☔️❤️ I can’t wait to see everyone and meet all your adorable Shih Tzus! 🐶💕 Whether you’re bringing one pup or a whole little crew, we’re excited to get everyone together for a fun day of wagging tails, pictures, and new furry friends! 📸🐾

Please share this post with anyone who was planning to attend so everyone has the updated date! 📣

Same park, same time, NEW DATE! 🐾❤️

Follow @dmvshihtzu for any additional updates!
